title: How Ukraine’s Drone Swarms Defeated a Giant Army
description:
Swarmed robots changed the front line.
A small army stopped a larger enemy with tech.

Ukraine’s story began as simple support drones.
Over winter, they evolved into lethal autonomous forces.
By 2024, ground and airborne swarms armed with grenade launchers
began sinking enemy UAVs, offsetting manpower gaps and re‑defining asymmetry in conflict. The film traces this David‑vs‑Goliath journey from traditional skirmishes to a high‑tech frontline.
